title: Density equals multiplicity a.e. where the support has unit density (Besicovitch differentiation)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult, mu := V.weight = (H^n restricted to M).withDensity (ofReal o theta), Sigma := V.support = U cap spt mu, H^n := muHE[n]), y0 in R^(n+l) and r0 real with B_{r0}(y0) contained in U; O := Bo_{r0}(y0). Assume H^n(Sigma cap O) < inf and, for every y in Sigma cap O, H^n(Sigma cap B_r(y)) / ofReal(omega_n r^n) -> 1 as r -> 0+. Then (a) for mu-a.e. y, y in O implies V.HasDensity y theta(y); and (b) for almost every y with respect to H^n restricted to Sigma cap O, y not in M implies V.HasDensity y 0.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (y₀ : Amb n ℓ) (r₀ : ℝ), closedBall y₀ r₀ ⊆ U → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀) < ⊤ → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.support ∩ closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)) → (∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, y ∈ ball y₀ r₀ → V.HasDensity y (V.mult y)) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀)), y ∉ V.carrier → V.HasDensity y 0
